# AGENTS.md — 01-swiss-saas

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Gridline**, saas landing, style "Swiss grid".
- Stack: Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `lib/content.ts` — all copy (EN + RU), board issues, logos
- `app/page.tsx` — every section as a small component
- `app/globals.css` — design tokens in Tailwind `@theme`
- `app/layout.tsx` — fonts and metadata

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # static export to ./out`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Bento grid with live mini-demos (typing command palette, burndown, keycaps) + changelog timeline.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Only one accent color — red is a signal, never decoration.
- Square corners everywhere. No rounded cards, no soft shadows; the only shadow is the hard offset under the product mock.
- Section headers always follow the pattern `NN —  Title` on a 1px ink rule.
- Headlines use negative tracking (-0.04em…-0.06em) and line-height below 1.
- Labels, IDs and meta are JetBrains Mono, small, uppercase where they are categories.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
